Based on the FY2024 (calendar-year, Jan 1–Dec 31) 10-K results for the five major U.S. airlines, all figures are directly comparable since each company reports on the same fiscal calendar basis:

| Airline | FY2024 Revenue | FY2024 Operating Income | Operating Margin | YoY Revenue Growth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Delta** | $61,643M | $5,995M | **9.73%** | 6.19% |
| United | $57,063M | $5,096M | 8.93% | 6.23% |
| American | $54,211M | $2,614M | 4.82% | 2.70% |
| Alaska | $11,735M | $570M | 4.86% | 12.56% |
| Southwest | $27,483M | $321M | 1.17% | 5.34% |

[DOC] United Airlines Holdings (CIK 100517, 10-K accession 0000100517-25-000046): Revenue FY2023 $53,717M, FY2024 $57,063M. Operating income FY2023 $4,211M, FY2024 $5,096M.

[DOC] American Airlines Group (CIK 6201, 10-K accession 0000006201-25-000010): Revenue FY2023 $52,788M, FY2024 $54,211M. Operating income FY2023 $3,034M, FY2024 $2,614M.

[DOC] Alaska Air Group (CIK 766421, 10-K accession 0000766421-25-000009): Revenue FY2023 $10,426M, FY2024 $11,735M. Operating income FY2023 $394M, FY2024 $570M.

[DOC] Southwest Airlines (CIK 92380, 10-K accession 0000092380-25-000024): Revenue FY2023 $26,091M, FY2024 $27,483M. Operating income FY2023 $224M, FY2024 $321M.

Analysis: All five companies report on a comparable calendar-year fiscal basis, so the data is directly comparable without adjustment. Delta posted the largest absolute revenue ($61.6B) and the largest absolute operating income ($6.0B) of the group, and it also generated the highest operating margin (9.73%), edging out United (8.93%). While Alaska had the fastest revenue growth (12.6%, partly reflecting integration of Hawaiian Airlines) and United had comparable margin/growth, Delta's combination of scale, profitability, and margin leadership makes it the strongest overall performer in FY2024. Southwest was the weakest, with only a 1.17% operating margin, reflecting well-documented operational and cost pressures during the year. American also lagged with margin compression (operating income fell from $3.03B to $2.61B) despite modest revenue growth.

ANSWER: Delta Air Lines was the strongest FY2024 performer among the five, with the highest revenue ($61.6B), highest operating income ($6.0B), and best operating margin (~9.7%), narrowly ahead of United; Southwest was the weakest (1.2% operating margin).
